scope_summary: Freeze Decimal-only, NUMERIC(20,8), ROUND_HALF_EVEN posting semantics without changing the transitional ledger implementation.
Separate REALIZED_GROSS and TRADE_FEE ledger postings from position-only realized net attribution.
Freeze FIFO opening-fee allocation, last-consumption remainder, long/short direction, HEDGE_BY_DIRECTION isolation, and stable event ordering.
Freeze cash, dividend, reversal, posting uniqueness, replay conflict, and unsupported-input error contracts.
Normalize evidence-gated IBKR signed commission to one non-negative aggregated fee and reject foreign fee currency.

Provide executable golden vectors for zero/one fee, repeated ADD, repeated partial REDUCE, full CLOSE, indivisible fee remainder, half-even rounding, long, short, hedge, cash, dividend, reversal, ordering, and rejection cases.
Scan three discovered SQLite samples with aggregate counts only and perform no data mutation.

IBKR commission normalization remains disabled until JRN-013 retains official field documentation and redacted real fixture evidence for sign and currency semantics.
